systems.owner: Commission Electorale Nationale Indépendante (CENI), through its technical directorate DIFEB
systems.tiers: single national file built from commune, arrondissement communal, regional, embassy and consulate lists; two of the four copies of each list are kept at the seat of the commune or arrondissement communal

systems.system: System for sending polling-station results up to the CENI

note: Electoral code (law of 2017 as amended in 2019; capture truncated at Article 156): communes appear as electoral constituencies, as the level of the CENI's temporary commissions and as where copies of the electoral list and the signed registers are kept; a law, and it states nothing about a commune office's connection, equipment or use of a system.
